description: This file contains service functions for managing comments within a task/project management platform, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting comments, with permission checks and activity recording.

methods.name: Task _ensure_member_and_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Ensures the user is a member of the project and that the specified task exists under the project.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all comments for a specific task within a project, verifying user access.

methods.name: Comment create_comment(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, body: str)
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a task, verifying user permissions, and records the activity.

methods.name: Comment update_comment(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, comment_id: int, user_id: int, body: str)
methods.description: Updates the body of an existing comment if the user is the author, with permission checks and activity logging.

methods.name: None delete_comment(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, comment_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a comment if the user is the author, with permission checks and activity recording.
